review_kind: independent static functional-parity review plus identified existing evidence; no builds or tests executed by this review

scope.initial_status: clean at review start; later parent-owned Cargo/identity edits preserved
scope.compatibility: fresh networks only; old wire/genesis/database/prover API compatibility deliberately excluded
scope.baseline_rpc_spec_stale_pin: The base RPC SPEC introduction still cites core9a1f8153; the actual a50 gitlink is84a5b520 and governs this comparison. Candidate documentation fixes that historical reference.

conclusion: Supported-profile parity largely preserved in code and existing process/live evidence. One reproduced public pending debug RPC gap; baseline A/B and current-head full gate remain separate pending work. All 26 static profile exclusions predate this branch.

matrix.baseline: Pinned Reth 2.7 / REVM / Alloy Ethereum interpreter and precompiles, ordinary signatures/nonces/gas/refunds/reverts; L2-specific lifecycle.
matrix.candidate: Same external dependency versions at b019. EezHandler reuses Ethereum execution; overrides native nonce handling and final ordinary base-fee credit. Plain and inspector paths share the handler.
matrix.pending: No same-workload main/candidate execution or throughput comparison has run in this review. Existing controls do not exhaust all Ethereum opcodes/precompiles.

matrix.baseline: Type 0x76, reserved 0xeeee...0076 sender, account nonce, wire [chainId,nonce,to,value,input], position-derived implicit gas.
matrix.candidate: Accepted fresh-network type 0x45/version 1, sender 0xffff...fffe, sourceHash and exact explicit position-derived gas, no account nonce, strict canonical RLP. Recorded history is an additional native kind.
matrix.pending: Old databases, genesis, wire decoders and old-network replay are deliberately unsupported. Generic clients must admit native type 0x45; Ethereum-only closed receipt enums do not.

matrix.baseline: Ordinary L2 execution supported by pinned EVM. Cross-chain front allowlist rejects 7702 envelopes because authorizations change other accounts nonces.
matrix.candidate: Same ordinary support and same front rejection. Delegation install/execution, subsequent delegated execution and revocation observed; native authorizationList remains empty.
matrix.pending: No claim of 7702 cross-chain envelope support or full 7702 conformance. Actual delegated-account/cross-chain combinations need separate scope and nonce-ownership analysis.

matrix.area: Blob DA versus user blobs and withdrawals
matrix.baseline: Native L1 blob DA; ordinary L2 EIP-4844 and beacon withdrawals rejected.
matrix.candidate: Same separation; complete blobs/KZG/semantic stream remain checked. No implicit beacon issuance added.
matrix.pending: An L1 type-3 posting receipt does not alone prove blob semantics; use the independent blob verifier and follower evidence.

matrix.area: Bidirectional mutable and grouped cross-chain execution
matrix.baseline: L1 plus one L2; nested alternating callbacks, complete source groups, source attribution, call/return bytes, value and root commitments.
matrix.candidate: Same pinned core tables, selectors and constraints; native source identities/lowering updated coherently. No multi-L2 or multiprover extension.
matrix.pending: Core-only support beyond the signer profile is not runtime support; see all 26 explicit exclusions.

matrix.baseline: Terminal failed calls and canonical non-overlapping rollback windows; no failed cross-chain calls with descendants or overlapping rollback.
matrix.candidate: Same restrictions. Source lookup-only failures do not create fabricated L2 deliveries; whole groups and failure returns remain bound.
matrix.pending: Add small negative controls for the seven exclusion classes at the real admission/signing boundary; no need to enable unsupported scenarios.

matrix.area: Static reads and position-bound lookup results
matrix.baseline: Terminal static reads and admitted successful terminal callbacks; mixed L2 static hosts only with flat successful mutable roots; same-position conflicting results rejected.
matrix.candidate: Same rules. Default suite plus L1 staticLocalWrite and staticThenNestedWrites checked independently; candidate reuse and callback hashes checked by extended collector.
matrix.pending: The two pinned MissingProxy staged terminal oracles were not reached in the fee-enabled live run. Earlier process tests cover that terminal; the new live early rejection is separate evidence.

matrix.area: Ordinary fees, settlement tariffs and quotes
matrix.baseline: Ethereum base-fee burning; tips, nested quotes, posting reservations, balance/nonce validation and exact tariff/refund paths.
matrix.candidate: Intentional base-fee credit to authenticated collector/FeeVault, after final gas/refunds; tips unchanged. Existing quote/pricing/reservation logic and final posting admission retained. FeeVault recipient is owner-rotatable.
matrix.pending: Compare main/candidate fees by formulas and returned execution, not identical amounts: mandatory history gas and L1 conditions differ. No performance ratio established.

matrix.baseline: No permanent authenticated scheduled L1-history predeploy/native import; standalone signer used configured canonical L1 source.
matrix.candidate: Consecutive checked L1 history from configured bootstrap, delayed scheduled recorded import or explicit repeat, same header/evm PREVRANDAO. Offline witnesses plus getCustomData bind anchor/profile/rules/current accepted root.
matrix.pending: Delay reduces ordinary reorg exposure; it is not finality. Reorg recovery remains required. History starts at the configured authenticated checkpoint, not automatically at arbitrary chain genesis.

matrix.baseline: Native DA and block-hash commitments; independent keyless follower, replay and prefix validation.
matrix.candidate: Follower derives new native/history format from L1/DA/genesis only; signer replays complete witnesses without chain RPC. Cold follower checked 206 complete batches, 3558 selected heights, 814 receipts and 112 catch-up parts.
matrix.pending: Replay checks selected complete canonical ranges and transaction hashes; listed receipt checks are status plus canonical block membership, not all receipt fields/logs. Partial claimed terminal 7134 is not relabeled applied; later complete 7146 is selected. No blanket proof for all unselected data.

matrix.area: Queue ownership, partial consumption, restart and reorg
matrix.baseline: Ownership retained until validated canonical consumption; partial accepted prefixes supported; retries bounded; pending queue/counters in memory.
matrix.candidate: Same contract, with history-aware reorg rewind and offline streaming sessions. Restart reconciles canonical state, not durable restoration of every pending client request.
matrix.pending: Receipt, post claim or matching height is insufficient. No durable in-memory queue recovery claim. Deliberate restart downtime is distinct from ordinary no-L1-information liveness.

matrix.area: Ordinary block production during unavailable L1/proving
matrix.baseline: Source and proving/submission deadlines constrained settlement; no new recorded-repeat import mechanism.
matrix.candidate: Independent local ordinary production; repeat selected L1 origin on scheduled imports; bounded settlement replacements cannot halt local production.
matrix.pending: Controlled 72-second observation/missed-slot/signer outages and bounded catch-up passed on identified earlier bytes. Neither four wall-clock days nor sustained mixed-load throughput is established; four days is optional stress, not required to test expired L1 blockhash.

matrix.baseline: Ordinary Ethereum calls, estimation, access lists and debug tracing over the pre-history EVM; native receipt type already nonstandard.
matrix.candidate: Public call/estimate/access-list pending fallback executes the validated native prefix; standard latest/historical selectors preserved. Public debug pending is still environment-only and fails at import boundaries.
matrix.pending: Fix and reproduce debug_traceCall pending on stable import/repeat parents without weakening history checks. Baseline exact RPC observation and WS/IPC transport probes remain pending. Engine-auth eth_call is a separate internal surface.

matrix.baseline: prove.v1 client-streamed Prove plus PrepareOrdinary/RetainOrdinaryRanges and leases; build/config identity; signer used a configured canonical L1 source.
matrix.candidate: One prove.v2 service, request-local witnesses, portable validation identity, bounded streaming/resume/rewind/cancel, same trusted ECDSA attestation model. External server endpoint already configurable.
matrix.pending: No old RPC compatibility required. No actual Nethermind server is present, so vectors/Rust tests do not establish C# execution interoperability. Optional server session controls must use specified bounded cold fallback.

matrix.baseline: Pinned Ethereum and Gnosis configurations; Reth v2.7 shutdown backport; existing strict identity and deployment tooling.
matrix.candidate: Same pinned external versions at b019; offline L1-rule commitment and genesis/profile checks added. Vendor shutdown README and sources unchanged between the two revisions.
matrix.pending: Both process profiles are covered; the retained Kurtosis live network is one concrete test network. Do not generalize to every custom genesis/network-rule transition. Parent-owned Tokio update after b019 is outside this frozen comparison.

constraints: Use separate checkout at exact main and its own scripts, manifests, contracts/genesis and fresh datadirs.
Fetch immutable OCI payloads, validate root/pin/lock/platform/archive and executable identities; no Cargo rebuild or fallback.
Existing run-native-suite invokes forge build; reuse only exact existing baseline deployment artifacts when avoiding all builds. Do not silently use current contracts.
Require nonzero --list/selection from each exact archived executable; same names alone do not establish equal assertions.
Run sequentially with owned disjoint enclave/container/port resources; freeze resource allocation and pause heavy task builds.
Do not reuse candidate chain state with 0x76 baseline binaries.
Compare identical ordinary/cross-chain application workloads and observable state/return/receipt outcomes; normalize only documented fee destinations/profile costs, never hashes/commitments.
Record offered/accepted/included/settled counts and latency separately; empty backlog replay is not comparative throughput.
Preserve first failures; no retry-only pass promotion.

minimal_followups.test: Reproduce exact stable-parent pending debug failure, reuse checked prefix for tracing, test advancing and repeated import plus malformed evidence and named/positional params. Keep tx_index/executed-payload semantics and historical tracing intact.
Use immutable main payloads and the shared exact filters above, then a capped same-workload mixed-traffic comparison with state, receipts, tariffs and follower checks.

One negative per seven exclusion classes, with accepted neighboring controls. Reach the intended materialization/authorization/signing error and assert no signature/canonical effect; do not count parser errors or core Anvil success as that proof.
Complete final candidate CI after helper/fixture/dependency fixes; preserve the earlier two CI failures and ignored inventory.
WS/IPC pending smoke and actual external Nethermind execution/settlement/replay are distinct future evidence; no actual external server is available in this repository.

limits: No core-only success is counted as signer support.
The 26 scenarios were classified statically from their pinned sources and profile; their whole live executions were not attempted here.
Candidate runtime live record is319ebc2d; b019 changes only helper/test/tooling paths, not node/signer source, but source equality is not a newly built b019 binary identity.
No performance comparison has been executed by this review.
Root-owned compatible Tokio update after b019 is outside this frozen comparison.
